title: Python adapter integration tests + end-to-end verification
description:
End-to-end integration tests exercising the full Python pipeline: parse → resolve imports → build graph → compute complexity → enrich FCA → tag effects. Verify on realistic Python patterns (classes with decorators, relative imports, async generators, comprehensions, test files).

Covers plan Step 8 from sutra/116. Also fills any test gaps from earlier sessions.

acceptance_criteria.text: End-to-end test: multi-file Python fixture with imports between files, verify sutra_deps returns resolved edges
Decorator FCA test: @staticmethod, @property, @pytest.fixture produce correct decorator:X attributes
Complexity end-to-end: function with nested if/for/try/comprehension scores correctly in both cyclomatic and cognitive
Effect end-to-end: function calling open(), requests.get(), subprocess.run() gets effect:fs, effect:net, effect:process
Async generator test: async def with yield gets both is_async and is_generator attrs
TestCase detection: class inheriting unittest.TestCase flagged as test
All pre-existing Rust/Dart/C tests still pass
sutra_status shows Python files as indexed when .py files are in workspace

execution_record: Implemented as planned — single test file, no modifications to production code needed. One test adjustment: the original testcase_detection test used `test_math.py` as filename, which triggers FLAG_TEST on all symbols via file-path matching. Fixed by using `math_utils.py` to test that TestCase inheritance and test_ prefix set the flag independent of filename, and that a non-test method (helper) does NOT get flagged. Pre-existing compile error in health-test.rs (stale insert_import call sites) is unrelated."

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex review (adversarial):

Two medium findings:
1. Import fixture didn't exercise src-layout package root discovery — FIXED in 93c2b92, added cross_file_import_resolution_src_layout test.
2. Status test bypasses sutra_status MCP handler — accepted as reasonable scope. sutra_status is a thin JSON wrapper over db.all_files(); testing the full MCP handler stack is disproportionate for an adapter integration test. The DB layer (which is the source of truth) is verified."
